difficulty_reason: Given u : F -> F(K_n) sheaf-surjective, build a morphism of hypercoverings f : L -> K with F(f_n) factoring through u: write K_n = {U_i -> X} so the target of u is coprod h_{U_i}; sheaf-surjectivity means for every i there is a covering {U_{ij} -> U_i} and maps t_{ij} : h_{U_{ij}} -> F with u o t_{ij} the canonical h_{U_{ij}} -> h_{U_i}; set J = coprod I_i, alpha : J -> I, V_j = U_{alpha(j)j} and Z = {V_j -> X}; then u' : Z -> K_n is a covering in SR(C,X) and F(u') : F(Z) -> F(K_n) factors through u by construction; the result follows from lemma-covering.
